description: Corner-relief v1 flat-pattern golden (docs/design/sheet-metal.md §4.4): the SAME authored corner tray as corner-tray-perp-unfold (rectangular base flange 40 x 30 mm + two edge flanges on PERPENDICULAR, corner-sharing edges), now with an EXPLICIT rectangular corner relief at the two bends' shared corner. The relief removes a size x size square of base material at the corner and insets each adjacent flange (+ its bend-allowance strip) by size at that end, so the developed blank gains a reentrant right-angle notch and area conservation holds with the removed material subtracted (§4.4.4, §9 #2). The 3D half (apply_corner_relief) cuts the manufacturable notch; the flat pattern is the authoritative deliverable and is computed ANALYTICALLY from the relief spec (decoupled from the 3D boolean), so it is exact and byte-deterministic (§9 #4).

relief.bends: both edge flanges of the tray (the two bends whose intersection is the shared base corner); the test builds the CornerRelief from the two evaluated CylindricalFaceSignatures (§5).

tangent_line_convention: Same as corner-tray-perp-unfold: each leg is measured to its bend TANGENT LINE (§9 #1); the base develops to its 40 x 30 flat top face, edge flange B (off x=40, axis +Y) develops leg 20 mm, edge flange A (off y=30, axis +X) develops leg 25 mm; two bend allowances REPLACE the two sharp-corner setbacks. Corner relief then insets each flange span by size_mm at the shared-corner end and removes the base's size_mm x size_mm corner square.
derivation: HAND-DERIVED analytic values. Base 40 (X) x 30 (Y) mm; flange off x=40 develops leg 20 mm over width 30 (along +Y axis); flange off y=30 develops leg 25 mm over width 40 (along +X axis); gauge t = 2 mm, inner radius r = 3 mm, both 90 deg, K = 0.44. Relief size s = relief_ratio * t = 1.0 * 2.0 = 2.0 mm.
Bend allowance (§1), both bends: BA = (pi/2)*(3 + 0.44*2) = 6.094689747964199 mm.

Relieved developed area (§9 #2 with removed material subtracted): flat_area = UNRELIEVED_area - removed, where UNRELIEVED_area = 3226.628282357494 (corner-tray-perp-unfold) and removed = base corner square (s*s = 4) + flange-B inset (s * (BA + 20) = 2 * 26.094689747964199 = 52.189379495928398) + flange-A inset (s * (BA + 25) = 2 * 31.094689747964199 = 62.189379495928398) = 118.3787589918568. flat_area = 3226.628282357494 - 118.3787589918568 = 3108.2495233656364 mm^2. The reentrant notch is a genuine CUT in the single closed outline, not a separate hole.

Envelope is UNCHANGED by relief (insets reduce each arm's SPAN, not its outward EXTENT): flat_length (frame-X extent) = 61.094689747964196 mm; bend_width (frame-Y extent) = 66.0946897479642 mm -- identical to the unrelieved tray.

Bend widths are the INSET spans: flange off x=40 span 30 -> 28, flange off y=30 span 40 -> 38, so bend_widths_mm = [28.0, 38.0]. Each fold line spans its flange's inset width; flat_end - flat_start == BA.

Outline: ONE closed loop with a single reentrant (270-deg) corner -- an L / staircase. Body edges: 6 (the relieved plus collapses to 6 rectilinear edges around the enlarged corner notch). Bend edges: 2 (one fold line per bend). The enclosed shoelace area of the body loop equals flat_area exactly (independent witness that the layout tiles the blank).

3D relieved body (apply_corner_relief): the notch is a square column of side 2*s = 4 mm centred on the two bend axes' closest point, subtracted from the folded body. It removes 24.826775361114414 mm^3 (relieved volume 6454.819167644028 vs base 6479.645943005143) and leaves ONE connected shell (the notch must not sever the sheet, §4.4). The removed 3D volume is NOT hand-derived (it trims the bent flange walls in a boolean-dependent way) -- the flat pattern, not the 3D cut, is the gated deliverable (§4.4.4); the 3D body is asserted for single-solid connectivity, material removal, and determinism only.

content_hash is the sha256 of the relieved FlatPattern.to_json_bytes() -- a DETERMINISM PIN reproducible in-process AND across a fresh interpreter restart (§9 #4). A change without a kernel-version bump is a determinism regression (P0).
tolerance_rationale: Same basis as corner-tray-perp-unfold (build123d 0.11.1 / OCCT 7.9): flat-pattern residuals vs hand-derived are ~1e-12 (area) / ~5e-12 (extents) / ~1e-11 (BA, from arc-fit inner-radius FP noise ~1e-14). Ceiling 1e-9 gives 2-3 orders of headroom while staying tighter than the kernel linear tolerance (1e-7 m). Volume tolerance 1e-6 absorbs arc-fit noise scaled by width.
